title: Why Rust is the future of systems programming

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know systems programming could be safe AND fast?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Modern systems are crashing, leaking memory, and costing billions.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Rust is a programming language that eliminates null pointer errors at compile time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its ownership model ensures memory safety without a garbage collector.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers at companies like Microsoft and Amazon are adopting it for critical systems.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Rust makes low-level code as reliable as high-level code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you tried Rust yet — or are you still stuck in the C++ era?

caption_text: Why Rust is the future of systems programming
